component.name: Loböle
component.summary: Parametric B-Rep CAD for parts, assemblies, drawings, and simulation

description.p: Loböle is an open-source parametric 3D CAD application built around a deterministic, scriptable document model. Create constrained sketches, solid features, assemblies, drawings, configurations, and FEM studies.
Projects use a diffable format with checkpoints and Git-backed history, while the same command layer is available to the GUI, Python, and MCP automation clients.
Edit faces directly, share sketches between parts, and import more formats.

ul.li: Direct edits: delete, offset, move and replace faces on any body, including imported ones, from the new Direct edit toolbar group. An edit that cannot be built is refused and names the faces it could not handle
Copy a sketch into another part, optionally linked so it follows the original
Import IGES and OBJ, choose the up axis when importing, and bring DXF or SVG drawings into a sketch

Sketching: G2 curvature and arc-length constraints, rescaling a sketch by its first dimension, open-end markers, trimming along a path, and typing name = value into a dimension to make a variable that drives it
Requirements can be written as expressions, and a design sweep checks them across a range of values
Mouse navigation can be set up in Preferences, Navigation, with presets for other CAD programs
Fillet, Chamfer, Shell and the other creation tools size their defaults from the part in front of them
When the graphics device is lost the app rebuilds it and carries on, and when the renderer cannot start it says why
Fixed: large projects stuttered every few seconds, most noticeably on Windows
Fixed: on Windows, a crash inside a system library on a background thread left no crash report, and the newest crash report could be the one cleaned away
Fixed: a fillet or chamfer on a rounded face's edge could pick a different edge after the file was reopened
Fixed: a fillet that could hang, a Shell that could give different results on different runs, and face moves that could take over a minute before giving up
Fixed: files with missing or damaged values are refused with the file and the value named, instead of opening with the value quietly dropped
Fixed: two running copies of the app no longer share one unsaved-work slot
Fixed: the sheet-metal flat pattern exported to DXF now cuts the whole blank
Fixed: placing a fastener, bearing or retaining ring is a single undo step
Fixed: building on Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04

description.p: Keep the dimension you just added.

ul.li: Dimensioning something the sketch already fixes names the dimension in the way and offers to use the new one instead, in one undo step
A dimension's right-click menu has Delete

description.p: Windows: the app starts when installed.

ul.li: The window no longer closes at start when the app is installed in its default folder, C:\Program Files\Loböle, or any other path with a non-ASCII character

description.p: The MCP server starts the AppImage by itself.

ul.li: With nothing running, the MCP server now attaches to an app it started through an AppImage or a Flatpak, instead of giving up after a minute

description.p: The full application as an AppImage for most Linux distributions.

ul.li: A GUI AppImage for any distribution with glibc 2.39 or newer: Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13, Fedora 40 and later
Parametric parts: constrained sketches, solid, sheet-metal and tube features, driven by variables and expressions
Assemblies with mates, motion studies and an exploded bill of materials
Drawings exported to SVG and PDF
FEM studies and topology optimisation
CAM: milling toolpaths, simulation and G-code, including a fourth axis
Git-backed history, checkpoints and merges of a diffable project format
A JSON-RPC interface with a Python SDK and an MCP server, the same command layer the GUI uses
